svg.title: Hash table with chaining collision resolution
svg.desc: Hash table of size 7 with keys 12,25,38,6,19 inserted using key mod 7, collisions resolved by chaining
svg.text: 12 mod 7=5 | 25 mod 7=4 | 38 mod 7=3 | 6 mod 7=6 | 19 mod 7=5 ← collision with 12!
Collision: two keys → same index (12 and 19 → index 5)
Chaining: linked list at each slot to hold all colliding keys
Average search: O(1 + α) ≈ O(1) for low load factor
Worst case: O(n) — all keys in one chain
Linear probing: next slot (index+1) mod m
Double hashing: use second hash function
